item.title: Adelaide breakout star Shabana Azeez cast opposite Hugo Weaving in drama The Airport Chaplain
item.description: Adelaide-raised actor Shabana Azeez is set to star alongside Hugo Weaving in SBS’s new drama The Airport Chaplain, an eight-part series exploring the human stories unfolding inside a bustling international airport.

item.title: A $17k property support giveaway is now open to women in South Australia
item.description: 28th Street Agency's EmpowerHER initiative is offering property support to one lucky woman, and applications are now open.

item.title: South Australian designer Paolo Sebastian stuns at the Grammys as Karol G, Halle Bailey and SZA wow in couture
item.description: Paolo Sebastian turned heads on the Grammy Awards red carpet, with Karol G, Halle Bailey and SZA showcasing breathtaking couture moments across the week’s biggest music events.

item.title: The Nest Golf Studio tees off as the Barossa’s first 24/7 indoor golf space
item.description: This fully female operated golf space has opened in the Barossa as a 24/7 indoor studio, with world-class training equipment for all skill levels.

item.title: COMING SOON: Beloved Melbourne Street Vietnamese eatery The Spot opens a new home in the Barossa
item.description: North Adelaide favourite The Spot is expanding to Tanunda this February, bringing its comforting Vietnamese flavours and laid-back hospitality to the heart of the Barossa.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Big Easy Radio’s new location is an 1875 stone cottage on a 30-acre McLaren Vale property
item.description: After nearly a decade in Aldinga, Big Easy Radio has opened a new McLaren Vale cellar door that reflects ten years of growth, premium winemaking and Australian lifestyle.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Wednesday February 4th and the days ahead
item.description: Adelaide is set for a run of sunny, low-to-mid 30s days, with extreme fire danger forecast for the Mount Lofty Ranges and UV levels remaining very high.

item.title: New awards celebrate South Australia’s male role models
item.description: South Australia’s first Positive Role Model Awards have been presented at Parliament House, recognising five men making a lasting impact across mental health, culture and community leadership.

item.title: SA’s CH4 Global wins two international sustainability gongs for methane-reducing innovation
item.description: South Australian company CH4 Global has won two international sustainability awards for its methane-reducing cattle feed Methane Tamer and its Eyre Peninsula EcoPark.

item.title: Bedford’s future secured as sale protects 1,250 supported workers
item.description: The sale of Bedford has been finalised, securing the future of the South Australian disability charity and protecting 1,250 supported workers and clients after joint State and Federal intervention.
